svg.title: The corridor with three doors, week twelve
svg.desc: An administration building with three office doors, a pending tray, a flowchart on a noticeboard and a handover note under a keyboard.

g.text: The corridor with three doors, week twelve
Twelve things to find. Four are a warning. Four are places a warning can stop.
the student centre, a missed call
the shared drive, two years old
an email marked FYI, read by one person
four crosses in a row, week three
the student, withdrew in week eleven
